tooltip.oraclearsenal.blink: Right-click: lock on, blink to the target, and draw a random weapon.
tooltip.oraclearsenal.ultimate: Sneak + right click: Furioso [Crescendo] (9 Hermes stacks)
tooltip.oraclearsenal.pager: Right click: receive an inexplicable prescript
tooltip.oraclearsenal.pager.note: Without the staff, nine readings lead to a trial; with the staff, all prescripts become available at random.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.0: Before the third bell, lend your shadow to a door.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.1: When the moon looks back, apologize to the nearest empty chair three times.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.2: Fold the final minute of yesterday and place it in your left pocket.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.3: Find the fourth path. Once found, return by the first.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.4: Count the gaps between raindrops. Disregard all falling water.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.5: Explain the sixth direction to the next chicken that sees you.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.6: Recite your name backwards tonight until it no longer belongs to you.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.7: Do not wake the sun while it is working the night shift.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.8: Open a window that has not yet been built for twelve seconds.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.9: Stand behind a clock and wait for it to greet you first.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.10: Ask the nearest villager whether today is the thirty-second.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.11: Sew tomorrow's dusk together with an invisible thread.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.12: When you cross water, leave your reflection where it is.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.13: Choose two identical stones and tell one of them it has lost.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.14: Put a stamp from the future on a letter never sent.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.15: From the seventh silence on the left, punctuation is forbidden.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.16: Check the attendance of every shadow before dawn.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.17: Find a tree that has never seen the sky. Call it the witness.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.18: Borrow a ruler from the horizon to measure your second thought.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.19: After your next sneeze, revoke the first step you took.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.20: Repay the mirror the expression you owe it before midnight.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.21: Classify every argument that never happened. Seal box zero.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.22: Follow the last footprint that left no mark.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.23: Circle a stranger you have not yet forgotten on a blank map.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.24: Ask a round stone for the secret of squares. Reject its answer.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.25: When cicadas sing, subtract one rainstorm from your age.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.26: Read the back of a fallen leaf counterclockwise.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.27: Before the river wakes, find a substitute course for it.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.28: Remember a room you have never dreamed of within thirty-nine seconds.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.29: Do not move. Let the block beneath you take one step toward you.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.30: Place east in your bag until west files an objection.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.31: In a windless place, submit a resignation letter to the wind.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.32: Give the next lightning strike a name only snails can read.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.33: From today onward, treat each Tuesday as a fragile object.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.34: When the second clock stops breathing, extinguish the first digit.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.35: Send the first question mark you meet today to yesterday's address.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.36: Complete an ocean report on behalf of sleeping ore.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.37: Distribute silence evenly among eight witnesses without mouths.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.38: Deliver an invitation from basement level seventeen to a flower.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.39: After counting nine stars, return the sky to its lender.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.40: Sort all colors by weight. Do not weigh red yet.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.41: Extract the curved portion of a straight line and preserve it.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.42: Enter the nearest shadow and register the light as a resident.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.43: Tell your right hand the promise your left forgot yesterday.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.44: Show a valid fishing license to a pond without fish.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.45: In the next rain, appoint a single droplet as your representative.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.46: Until the third dawn, do not testify on behalf of dusk.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.47: Use yesterday's key on the day-after-tomorrow's lock. Do not enter.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.48: Hold a grand funeral for a story not yet written.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.49: When a distant dog barks, rename the nearest window “sea.”
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.50: Tear out page four, then confirm the book has only three pages.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.51: Raise an invisible sign in the quietest place you know.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.52: Write down the birthday of the first stone you meet. Year unknown.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.53: Walk opposite your shadow until you encounter its father.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.54: Remove a grain of time that has not passed from the hourglass.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.55: Tonight, guard a mistake you will only make tomorrow.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.56: Deliver all unclaimed echoes to recipient number nine.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.57: Fold the sound of your footsteps and hand it to the nearest stairs.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.58: Tell the last train the first train's dream. Do not explain.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.59: When the world blinks, count the missing second for it.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.60: Stick a pen into the center of a city absent from the map.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.61: Await the instruction that was never sent. This is that instruction.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.62: Locate the nearest “far away” and write zero on it.
message.oraclearsenal.prescript.63: This instruction cannot be followed. Follow it diligently.
tooltip.oraclearsenal.rien_mask: A fractured porcelain half-mask. The wound beneath will never heal.
tooltip.oraclearsenal.rien_mask_equipmen: Right-click to equip on head; covers the left side of the face. 1 armor point.
message.oraclearsenal.need_weapon: Equip Oracle Terminal · Caduceus in the main hand first.
message.oraclearsenal.busy: A finisher is already in progress.
message.oraclearsenal.need_hermes_charge: Requires 9 Hermes charges to use the V-key ultimate
message.oraclearsenal.trial.overworld: The special prescript can only be decoded in the Overworld.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.no_site: No safe trial location nearby. Move elsewhere and try again.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.special: §l[Tenth Prescript] Travel to the coordinates and face Rien.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.location: Trial location (Overworld): X %s / Y %s / Z %s. Rien appears when you approach.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.in_progress: Defeat Rien after he removes his mask and enters phase two.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.start: Rien has appeared. Complete his challenge.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.complete: You have passed the trial. If you lose your staff, use the pager to challenge Rien again while carrying no staff.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.staff_carrie: You are carrying the Oracle Terminal: Twin Serpent Staff. The Rien challenge cannot be activated while you have it.
message.oraclearsenal.trial.special_repe: §l[Renewed Trial] You carry no Twin Serpent Staff. Travel to the new coordinates to challenge Rien again.
If you encounter Tennol, smile at them.
Unite a ray of red light with a ray of purple light.
When the camera starts rolling, pursue someone who possesses a Stand.
Seize an arrow among the floating islands, and awaken the dreams of others.
Become a skeleton, and pierce through with an enormous laser.
Choose your own trolley problem, and define elegance for yourself.
When you are lonely and in pain, unable to go on, take your own hand and resume the journey together.
After overcoming a mighty foe, debate the meaning of fairy tales and stories with a young girl.
After defeating the being circling at the end of the world, listen to the universe converse.
If you do not know where to go, perhaps you should journey to a distant land.
Cherish what matters to you with a gentle touch.
Sing into the void, so the world remembers your shadow upon the wall.
If they are willing, embrace everyone you have met, then embrace a representative of another world.
Travel through time and space, and collect a few cards.
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.1: When you sever the ribs with the hand axe…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.2: When you pierce the lungs with the awl…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.3: When you shatter the shoulder with the hand-and-a-half sword…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.4: When you should open more than ten holes in the body with the rapier…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.5: When you should crush the back of the skull with the hammer…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.6: When you should cleave the torso with the greatsword…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.7: When you should pierce a 20-inch hole with the lance…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.8: When you should whip away ten thousand chunks of flesh…
message.oraclearsenal.weapon_prescript.9: When you should use the scythe… to cleave space like someone once did…
message.oraclearsenal.rien_ultimate_pres: Reenact someone's fury, and tear open the sky with a scythe.
Follow the will of Hermes, and listen to the sound of the waves.
In the abyss, preserve that furious heart.
